meta.source: client/src/index.css (the portfolio site) — the site is the reference; change both together.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Identity colour. The dark ground of every social image and video frame; strokes of the SS mark on light grounds; text on saffron.

tokens.name: brand-saffron
tokens.usage: Identity colour. Panels, the mark's first pad, chips and highlights. A fill, never small text on light grounds (2.0:1 on paper).

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Identity colour. Light ground of documents and the light site; strokes of the mark on ink.

tokens.name: brand-ink-2
tokens.usage: The ink panel on light pages (the light hero, the core-stack band) and text on paper in documents.

tokens.name: saffron-light
tokens.usage: Hover state of saffron fills and secondary saffron in documents (rules, table headers on ink).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and canvas background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: navigation bar, modals.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, input fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Section rules, the line under a group heading, dashed placeholders.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg, surface and card (16:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and descriptions on bg and card (8.3:1 dark, 6.9:1 light).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, mono labels, counts. Below 4.5:1 (4.4 dark, 3.6 light): only for text 19px bold or larger, or for labels that repeat information shown elsewhere.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron fills in both themes. Put `on-accent` text on it.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Saffron words in running text: eyebrows, the Arabic line of the name, highlighted words. 8.5:1 on dark bg; 4.0:1 on light bg, so in light use it at 19px bold or larger only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on saffron (8.5:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The 'taking new projects' dot only, always beside its words.

families.body: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The name in the hero, video title cards. Arabic: line height 1.25, no negative tracking.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles, post and thumbnail titles (scale up to fit the format). Arabic: line height 1.35.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: أبني تطبيقات ويب بتشتغل بالعربي والإنجليزي.
styles.usage: Running text everywhere, Arabic and English.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Notes under items, table cells in documents.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows above section titles, counts, file names, meta lines in documents. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: roles
styles.sample: Software Engineer · Full-Stack Developer · Content Creator
styles.usage: The roles line under the name, separated by a middle dot.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, icon and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section header to content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gutter at desktop width (the site uses clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px)).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, the core-stack band.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pad
tokens.usage: Pads (the circles at the end of a trace) and status dots. Corners of panels are cut at 45°, not rounded.

tokens.name: trace-width
tokens.usage: Stroke of the SS traces in the mark's own 100-unit width (6.5% of the mark's width). Keep this ratio when drawing traces at any size.

tokens.name: pad-radius
tokens.usage: Radius of a pad in the same units.
